release.content: integrations 0.14.4 was released on 2026-11-16 from commit cd299d5b74c36c30fa5bac4685481306168257ce with these changes.

rows: integrations ci-usage: CI's wait times and compute load for platform.ci_jobs and platform.cluster_usage, through storage's ci-usage buffer. `jobs` (k8s/ci-jobs.yaml, every ten minutes, as the release reader app) writes each finished GitHub Actions job of the board's repositories once, with wait_seconds and run_seconds, its state a head in the ci-jobs tenant; `--since-days 90` backfills. `cluster` writes the k3s server's node, namespace, ci (quota, runners) and runner rows, with each runner pod's cgroup memory.peak; avrofile has encode_ci_jobs, encode_cluster_usage and their decoders

The ingest pod loads any number of buffers more: INGEST_BUFFERS, [{"tenant": ..., "dataset": ..., "table": ...}], so one dataset holds several Kinds (platform's ci_jobs and cluster_usage, both from the tenant ci-usage, beside pubkit_checks); Kinds sharing a tenant keep their batch records apart (batches/<table>-). INGEST_SIGNALS, INGEST_NEED_STATES and INGEST_PUBKIT_CHECKS work as before
